scope: Concept-brief refactor and free web beta
interpretation: Implemented means available in the code and verified as described; it does not claim user-research acceptance, signed-device validation, or commercial activation.

requirements.delivery: Night palette, original cosmic imagery, gold actions, existing Fraunces/DM Sans typography and three-tab navigation.
30 illustrated possibilities, curiosity/love/pass, undo, skip, resume and early continuation.
Three optional stories, a first why and source-linked Chloe discovery proposals requiring confirmation.
Optional versioned baseline with the same three questions as monthly reviews; skipped answers stay null.
Be, People, Causes, Passions, Grow and Surprise; editable suggestions and one intention per day.
Action or way of being, planet, optional value, time/context, place, beneficiary and companion, with explicit review.
Steady orbit, variety or guidance preferences persisted and included in Chloe context.
Completion, energy and value choice stored independently; discoveries can be confirmed through Chloe or added to the galaxy.
Why at the galaxy centre, accepted versions, source-linked proposals and restoration through a new version.
Separate interests, values, strengths and admired people; a daily beneficiary does not become an admired person automatically.
Spark/Glow/Blaze from explicit signals; Craft and Ember are deliberate choices. No decay after absence.
Flicker/Steady/Drift from explicit value responses, independent of completion.
Searchable curated catalog, domain filters, first steps, indicative time/access/cost, related possibilities and try/save/pass.
Session modes, versioned prompt, bounded history, structured saved facts, current why and durable preferences; confirmation before saving proposals.
requirements.remaining: Original author master prompt was not supplied. Retrieval uses bounded structured context, without semantic search or automatic rolling summaries.

requirements.delivery: Persisted deferred/stopped questions, explicit reopening and conservative suppression when context limits are reached.
Meaning To backlog with do, defer and release; review eligibility after 14 days or three passes.
Weekly reflection, one due rhythm at a time, deferral and a longer Chloe session entry.
One-year and life pictures, optional planet details, separate versions and still true/tweak/changed choices.
Calendar-month Full Moon review, same versioned questions, hidden scores until requested and separately consented product feedback.
Why revisit every third completed monthly review or on demand, using source clues and explicit acceptance.
Private daily beneficiary and user-initiated prepared sharing.
Expiring, revocable Comet links, no-account viewing, try/save/pass/block and no sender-visible recipient response.
requirements.remaining: Recipient blocking and daily limits are device-local before sign-in and resettable by clearing storage; they are not verified-person abuse controls.

requirements.delivery: Private dated list of real shared moments without relationship ranking.
Guest friend replies, private owner review, approval before adding, deduplication and bounded submissions.
Opt-in native biometric/device lock on background return; account sign-out clears web account cache.
requirements.remaining: Real-device authentication and signed native lifecycle checks. Local storage is not an encrypted journal vault.

requirements.delivery: Opt-in content-free activation/session/action/reflection/review/AI events and separate consented feedback; private scores stay private.
requirements.remaining: D7/D30 can be derived administratively from events; no analytics dashboard or production cohort results are claimed.

requirements.delivery: Explicitly free beta, server-owned entitlements and sponsor redemption; no charge or artificial trial.
requirements.remaining: Paid checkout, billing provider and verified subscription webhooks are not activated.

requirements.delivery: Atomic seat-limited sponsor codes, coach invitation links and previewed weekly action-title sharing; no employer journal access.
requirements.remaining: Provision real sponsor codes; aggregate reporting and coach/employer dashboards are not shipped.

requirements.delivery: Expo web export, installable manifest/icons, Vercel configuration, native build profiles, reminder routing and local authentication.
requirements.remaining: Custom SMTP and actual email delivery; owner signing credentials, physical-device notifications/biometrics and native distribution.

requirements.delivery: Public About/landing route with honest feature copy and Find my Sparks entry; invitation links work without accounts.
requirements.remaining: A separate acquisition tool, campaigns and partner reporting remain later commercial work.

verification.code: TypeScript, ESLint and ten domain tests passed.
verification.exports: Web, Android and iOS exports passed; native exports are not signed builds.
verification.database: Ownership, import and journey SQL checks passed with rolled-back fixtures; migrations applied.
verification.browser: Guest journey, contextual authentication and draft/import regressions on Chrome; mock authentication separated from live integration.
verification.live: Real authentication callback, Chloe response, message and why persistence, guest Comet and private friend suggestions verified with an ephemeral account; no email sent.
verification.security: No Supabase database advisor errors. Existing leaked-password Auth warning and upstream Expo-toolchain npm advisories remain documented in README.
